question: What is the pettiest revenge you have ever pulled off?
story: My neighbor stole my packages for six months, so I mailed myself a box of glitter and a tracking device. He was smug about it. Every time something went missing he would stand on his porch and tell me the delivery guys in this neighborhood were useless. Meanwhile I could see my own kitchen mixer on his living room table through the window. Cameras did not help. The police said they needed proof it left my property and entered his. So I built the proof. I ordered a cheap tile tracker, taped it inside a box, filled that box with two pounds of craft glitter, and shipped it to my own address. It vanished in eleven minutes. The tracker pinged from inside his house for three straight days. Here is the best part. He opened it. He came to my door covered in silver glitter to accuse me of setting him up. He was wearing my evidence.
